semantics.R0: Existing P2-A Policy A replay; actual entry VWAP, modeled exit fee and 1bp exit slippage.
semantics.R1: Actual entry VWAP and frozen Policy A stop/1.5R target; exact 1m path, gross only.
semantics.R2: R1 plus P1 0.60R->+0.05R and 1.00R->+0.40R stop locks, exchange tick rounding, conservative stop-first intrabar and next-bar effectiveness.
semantics.R3: Actual V2 exchange reduce-only fills; gross and commission-net, excluding funding.
semantics.p1_observed: Only ProfitProtectionStopTightened events count as historical runtime replacement evidence; a P1 policy label alone is not a replacement.
